name: Reactome_get_pathway_reactions
description: Query all reactions and subpathways contained under a Pathway using Pathway Stable ID. Returns list of events (reactions and subpathways) contained in the pathway, including their metadata and relationships.

stId.description: Pathway Stable ID (e.g., 'R-HSA-73817'). To find pathway IDs, use Reactome_list_top_pathways to get top-level pathways, or Reactome_map_uniprot_to_pathways if you have a UniProt protein ID.
Stable identifier

isInDisease.description: Whether event is associated with disease

eventOf.description: Parent events (can be IDs or objects)

schemaClass.description: Schema class (e.g., 'Reaction', 'Pathway')

return_schema.description: List of events (reactions or subpathways), can be IDs or full objects

name: Reactome_get_pathway_hierarchy
description: Get the hierarchy (parent pathways) for a pathway. Returns list of parent pathways.

stId.description: Pathway Stable ID (e.g., 'R-HSA-73817'). To find pathway IDs, use Reactome_list_top_pathways to get top-level pathways, or Reactome_map_uniprot_to_pathways if you have a UniProt protein ID.

name: Reactome_list_top_pathways
description: List top-level pathways for a specific species. Returns pathways that have no parent pathways, including their metadata and basic information.

species.description: Species name or taxonomy ID (e.g., 'Homo sapiens' or '9606'). IMPORTANT: Common names like 'human' or 'mouse' will return HTTP 404. Use exact scientific name (e.g., 'Homo sapiens', 'Mus musculus') or NCBI taxonomy ID. To find available species, use Reactome_list_species.

stId.description: Stable identifier

isInDisease.description: Whether pathway is associated with disease

schemaClass.description: Schema class (e.g., 'Pathway')

species.description: Species the reaction is annotated in, each with its dbId and name.

doi.description: DOI of the pathway, for pathways Reactome has published one for.

lastUpdatedDate.description: When the pathway was last revised, e.g. '2022-12-07'.

releaseStatus.description: Reactome's release state for the pathway, when set.

name: Reactome_get_reaction
description: Get detailed information about a specific reaction/event by its Stable ID. Returns comprehensive reaction data including inputs, outputs, regulation, literature references, and participants. Uses the unified query endpoint. Use Reactome_get_pathway_reactions to get valid reaction IDs first.

stId.description: Reaction Stable ID (e.g., 'R-HSA-111289'). To find reaction IDs, use Reactome_get_pathway_reactions with a pathway ID to get all reactions in that pathway.
Stable identifier

isInDisease.description: Whether reaction is associated with disease

input.description: Input entities (can be IDs or objects)

output.description: Output entities (can be IDs or objects)

schemaClass.description: Schema class (e.g., 'Reaction')

species.description: Species the reaction is annotated in, each with its dbId and name.

compartment.description: Cellular compartments the reaction occurs in, each with a GO accession, e.g. cytosol / 0005829. A reaction without its compartment cannot be placed in a cell.

summation.description: Reactome's prose summary of the reaction, with its own dbId. The only field that explains what the reaction does.

reviewStatus.description: How far the reaction has been through Reactome's review, as a term with a definition. What separates a curated reaction from a newly added one.

orthologousEvent.description: The same reaction inferred in other species, each with its stId. This is how a human reaction is mapped onto a model organism.

negativePrecedingEvent.description: Events that must NOT have happened for this reaction to proceed, e.g. a futile cycle. Dropping these inverts part of the pathway logic.

maxDepth.description: Depth of the event hierarchy below this reaction.

name: Reactome_get_complex
description: Get detailed information about a protein complex by its Stable ID. Returns comprehensive complex data including subunits, compartments, and related information. Uses the unified query endpoint that works for all entity types.

stId.description: Complex Stable ID (e.g., 'R-HSA-3209194', the TP53 Tetramer). To find complex IDs, use Reactome_get_participants with a reaction ID to see complexes participating in that reaction. Passing a Pathway or Reaction stId here will still return data (the endpoint is unified across entity types), but the response's schemaClass will not be 'Complex'.
Stable identifier

isInDisease.description: Whether complex is associated with disease

hasComponent.description: Complex subunits/components. Reactome fully expands the first occurrence of each distinct subunit but lists repeated (homomeric) copies as a bare dbId integer instead of repeating the full object.

schemaClass.description: Schema class (e.g., 'Complex')

maxDepth.description: Depth of the event hierarchy below this reaction.

species.description: Species the reaction is annotated in, each with its dbId and name.

inDisease.description: Whether the complex is annotated as disease-associated. A disease variant of a complex is not the normal one.

inferredTo.description: Species the complex was computationally inferred into, each with its stId. Inference is not observation, and this is the only field that says which this is.

isChimeric.description: True when the complex is built from components of different species - an inferred construct, not an observed one.

name: Reactome_get_interactor
description: Get detailed information about an interactor (protein, complex, or small molecule) by its Stable ID. Returns comprehensive interactor data including reference entities, compartments, and related pathways. Uses the unified query endpoint that works for all entity types.

stId.description: Interactor Stable ID. To find interactor IDs, use Reactome_get_participants with a reaction ID, or Reactome_map_uniprot_to_pathways/Reactome_map_uniprot_to_reactions if you have a UniProt protein ID.
Stable identifier

isInDisease.description: Whether interactor is associated with disease

compartment.description: Cellular compartments the event takes place in

stId.description: Stable identifier, where the object has one

schemaClass.description: Reactome class of the referenced object

name: Reactome_list_species
description: List all species available in Reactome database.

schemaClass.description: Schema class (e.g., 'Reaction')

abbreviation.description: Reactome's short code for the species, e.g. 'HPV'. What its other endpoints expect.

name: Reactome_query_by_ids
description: Query Reactome by providing a list of Reactome stable identifiers (R-HSA-*). Returns detailed information about pathways, reactions, or other entities. Note: This endpoint requires Reactome stable IDs, not external IDs (UniProt, ChEBI). Use mapping endpoints first to convert external IDs to Reactome IDs.

ids.description: List of Reactome stable identifiers (e.g., 'R-HSA-73817', 'R-HSA-111289'). Must be Reactome stable IDs, not external IDs. To find pathway IDs, use Reactome_list_top_pathways. To find reaction IDs, use Reactome_get_pathway_reactions. To convert external IDs (UniProt) to Reactome IDs, first use Reactome_map_uniprot_to_pathways or Reactome_map_uniprot_to_reactions.

species.description: NOT SUPPORTED by this endpoint; supplying it returns an error. Reactome's /data/query/ids performs no server-side species filtering, so the request cannot be honoured. Filter the returned array client-side on each record's 'speciesName', or use Reactome_list_top_pathways / Reactome_get_events_hierarchy, which take species as a path parameter.

types.description: NOT SUPPORTED by this endpoint; supplying it returns an error. Reactome's /data/query/ids performs no server-side type filtering, so the request cannot be honoured. Filter the returned array client-side on each record's 'schemaClass' (e.g. 'Pathway', 'Reaction').

stId.description: Stable identifier

isInDisease.description: Whether entity is associated with disease

input.description: Input entities (can be IDs or objects, for reactions)

output.description: Output entities (can be IDs or objects, for reactions)

schemaClass.description: Schema class (e.g., 'Pathway', 'Reaction')

negativePrecedingEvent.description: Events that must NOT have happened for this reaction to proceed, e.g. a futile cycle. Dropping these inverts part of the pathway logic.

reviewStatus.description: How far the reaction has been through Reactome's review, as a term with a definition. What separates a curated reaction from a newly added one.

species.description: Species the reaction is annotated in, each with its dbId and name.

summation.description: Reactome's prose summary of the reaction, with its own dbId. The only field that explains what the reaction does.

figure.description: Figures Reactome attaches to the event.

goBiologicalProcess.description: The GO biological process the event is equated with, with its accession. The bridge from Reactome to GO.

hasDiagram.description: Whether Reactome has drawn a diagram for the event. Determines whether it can be shown rather than only listed.

hasEHLD.description: Whether an Enhanced High Level Diagram exists - Reactome's illustrated overview rather than the schematic.

hasEvent.description: The events contained in this one, each with its stId. The pathway's structure.

lastUpdatedDate.description: When Reactome last changed the record, e.g. '2022-12-07'.

items.description: Detailed information about pathways, reactions, or other entities

name: Reactome_get_database_version
description: Get Reactome database version information. Returns version number as integer.

name: Reactome_get_event_ancestors
description: Get ancestor events (parent pathways) for a reaction or pathway.

stId.description: Event Stable ID (pathway or reaction, e.g., 'R-HSA-73817'). To find pathway IDs, use Reactome_list_top_pathways. To find reaction IDs, use Reactome_get_pathway_reactions with a pathway ID.

items.description: Each element is an array of ancestor events (hierarchy path)

name: Reactome_map_uniprot_to_pathways
description: Map a UniProt protein identifier to Reactome pathways. Returns all pathways that contain this protein.

uniprot_id.description: UniProt protein accession (e.g., 'P04637' for TP53, 'P00533' for EGFR)

stId.description: Stable identifier

isInDisease.description: Whether pathway is associated with disease

schemaClass.description: Schema class (e.g., 'Pathway')

doi.description: DOI of the record, where one exists.

items.description: Pathway objects containing the UniProt protein

name: Reactome_map_uniprot_to_reactions
description: Map a UniProt protein identifier to Reactome reactions. Returns all reactions that involve this protein.

uniprot_id.description: UniProt protein accession (e.g., 'P04637' for TP53, 'P00533' for EGFR)

stId.description: Stable identifier

isInDisease.description: Whether reaction is associated with disease

schemaClass.description: Schema class (e.g., 'Reaction')

isChimeric.description: True when the entity is built from components of different species - an inferred construct rather than an observed one.

items.description: Reaction objects involving the UniProt protein

name: Reactome_get_participants
description: Get all participants (physical entities) of a reaction or event. Returns list of physical entities (proteins, complexes, small molecules) participating in the event, including their reference entities.

stId.description: Event Stable ID (reaction or pathway, e.g., 'R-HSA-111289'). To find reaction IDs, use Reactome_get_pathway_reactions with a pathway ID. To find pathway IDs, use Reactome_list_top_pathways.

schemaClass.description: Schema class (e.g., 'Complex', 'SimpleEntity')

refEntities.description: Reference entities (UniProt, ChEBI, etc.) associated with this participant

items.description: Physical entity participating in the event

name: Reactome_get_participant_reference_entities
description: Get reference entities for participants of a reaction or event. Returns list of reference entities (UniProt proteins, ChEBI chemicals, etc.) associated with the participants, including database identifiers and names.

stId.description: Event Stable ID (reaction or pathway, e.g., 'R-HSA-111289'). To find reaction IDs, use Reactome_get_pathway_reactions with a pathway ID. To find pathway IDs, use Reactome_list_top_pathways.
Stable identifier (e.g., 'uniprot:Q06203')

otherIdentifier.description: Further identifiers the source database carries

schemaClass.description: Schema class

checksum.description: Checksum of that sequence; the way to tell whether the sequence behind an identifier has changed

isSequenceChanged.description: Whether the sequence changed since Reactome annotated it. An annotation made against a sequence that has since changed may no longer hold

chain.description: Chain information for the reference sequence

moleculeType.description: What kind of molecule the entity is

url.description: Resolvable URL for the entity in its source database

name: Reactome_get_pathways_low_entity
description: Get low-level pathways (most specific pathways) containing a specific entity. Returns pathways at the lowest level of the hierarchy.

id.description: Entity Stable ID (pathway, reaction, or physical entity, e.g., 'R-HSA-73817'). To find pathway IDs, use Reactome_list_top_pathways. To find reaction IDs, use Reactome_get_pathway_reactions. To find entity IDs, use Reactome_get_participants.

name: Reactome_get_entity_events
description: Get events (reactions/subpathways) associated with an entity. Returns TSV-formatted event data parsed into structured JSON. The API returns tab-separated values (ID, name, type) which are automatically converted to JSON format.

stId.description: Entity Stable ID (pathway, e.g., 'R-HSA-73817'). To find pathway IDs, use Reactome_list_top_pathways to get top-level pathways, or Reactome_map_uniprot_to_pathways if you have a UniProt protein ID.

items.description: Event objects (reactions or subpathways) parsed from TSV format

name: Reactome_get_entity_compartment
description: Get compartment information for an entity. Returns TSV-formatted compartment data parsed into structured JSON. The API returns tab-separated values (ID, name, type) which are automatically converted to JSON format.

stId.description: Entity Stable ID (e.g., 'R-HSA-73817'). To find pathway IDs, use Reactome_list_top_pathways. To find reaction IDs, use Reactome_get_pathway_reactions. To find entity IDs, use Reactome_get_participants.

return_schema.description: Compartment information parsed from TSV format. An entity in one compartment comes back as a single object, an entity in several comes back as a list, and an entity in none comes back as an empty list -- measured across nine stable IDs: 3 single, 2 lists of 2-3, 4 empty.

oneOf.description: The entity is in exactly one compartment

name: Reactome_get_events_hierarchy
description: Get the full event hierarchy (pathways and reactions) for a specific species. Returns complete nested hierarchy structure with top-level pathways and their children (subpathways and reactions). Note: Use taxonomy ID (e.g., '9606') for best results.

species.description: Species taxonomy ID (e.g., '9606' for Homo sapiens) or species name. Taxonomy ID is recommended. To find available species and their taxonomy IDs, use Reactome_list_species.

stId.description: Stable identifier

children.description: Child events (subpathways and reactions), recursively nested

items.description: Top-level pathway with nested hierarchy structure

name: Reactome_get_diseases
description: Get list of disease pathways or DOIDs (Disease Ontology IDs) annotated in Reactome. Returns disease-related pathway information including database identifiers, definitions, and names.

schemaClass.description: Schema class

items.description: Disease pathway objects with DOID annotations
